name: PT Perdana Bangun Pusaka Tbk
summary: PT Perdana Bangun Pusaka Tbk engages in the sale and distribution of photographic products in Indonesia. The company operates in two segments, Trading and Services. It offers color paper, dye sub paper, x-ray film, and photo paper. The company operates through retail stores or representative offices. In addition, it leases office spaces. The company was formerly known as PT Konica Cemerlang and changed its name to PT Perdana Bangun Pusaka Tbk in April 1988. PT Perdana Bangun Pusaka Tbk was founded in 1987 and is based in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
